117	            SortParam(

127	            ).dynamic_depends()
128	        ),
129	    ],
130	    filename_pattern: QueryParseImportErrorFilenamePatternSearch,
131	    session: SessionDep,
132	    user: GetUserDep,
133	) -> ImportErrorCollectionResponse:
134	    """Get all import errors."""
135	    auth_manager = get_auth_manager()
136	    readable_dag_ids = auth_manager.get_authorized_dag_ids(method="GET", user=user)
137	
138	    # Subquery for files that have any DAGs
139	    files_with_any_dags = select(DagModel.relative_fileloc).distinct().subquery()
140	
141	    # CTE for DAGs the user can read
142	    visible_files_cte = (
143	        select(DagModel.relative_fileloc, DagModel.dag_id, DagModel.bundle_name)
144	        .where(DagModel.dag_id.in_(readable_dag_ids))
145	        .cte()
146	    )
147	
148	    # Prepare the import errors query by joining with the cte.
149	    # Each returned row will be a tuple: (ParseImportError, dag_id)
150	    import_errors_stmt = (
151	        select(ParseImportError, visible_files_cte.c.dag_id)
152	        .outerjoin(
153	            files_with_any_dags,
154	            ParseImportError.filename == files_with_any_dags.c.relative_fileloc,
155	        )
156	        .outerjoin(
157	            visible_files_cte,
158	            and_(
159	                ParseImportError.filename == visible_files_cte.c.relative_fileloc,
160	                ParseImportError.bundle_name == visible_files_cte.c.bundle_name,
161	            ),
162	        )
163	        .where(
164	            or_(
165	                files_with_any_dags.c.relative_fileloc.is_(None),
166	                visible_files_cte.c.dag_id.isnot(None),
167	            )
168	        )
169	        .order_by(ParseImportError.id)
170	    )
171	
172	    # Paginate the import errors query
173	    import_errors_select, total_entries = paginated_select(
174	        statement=import_errors_stmt,
175	        filters=[filename_pattern],
176	        order_by=order_by,
177	        offset=offset,
178	        limit=limit,
179	        session=session,
180	    )
181	    import_errors_result: Iterable[tuple[ParseImportError, Iterable]] = groupby(
182	        session.execute(import_errors_select), itemgetter(0)
183	    )
184	
185	    import_errors = []
186	    for import_error, file_dag_ids_iter in import_errors_result:
187	        dag_ids = [dag_id for _, dag_id in file_dag_ids_iter if dag_id is not None]
188	
189	        if not dag_ids:
190	            import_errors.append(import_error)
191	            continue
192	
193	        # Check if user has read access to all the DAGs defined in the file
194	        requests: Sequence[IsAuthorizedDagRequest] = [
195	            {
196	                "method": "GET",
197	                "details": DagDetails(id=dag_id),
198	            }
199	            for dag_id in dag_ids
200	        ]

204	        import_errors.append(import_error)
205	
206	    return ImportErrorCollectionResponse(
